mount._note_aim: 23 Nov 2026 (owner's follow-up): the mount faces joystick travel and runs forward as before. The cat acquires and shoots only within aim_cone_deg either side of that heading (140 each side, a 280-degree arc). aim_cone_keep_deg is zero so held targets are released outside it; the rear blind spot is 80 degrees. Dedicated upper-body mounted Front, QuarterLeft/Right and RearLeft/Right shooting clips blend across this arc. The character root, pelvis and seated legs keep facing the mount; only the torso, shoulders, arms and head aim. The rear poses limit chest rotation and reposition both arms for an over-shoulder shot. Draw and release stay synchronized with Shoot. Pose values are authored animation data in assets/cat/mounted/shooting.res.
mount._note_ride: 22 Nov 2026 (the owner: 'the cat is stationary while riding; make the cat move'): how the seated cat moves (ride_motion.gd, all looks only, no gameplay). Angles in degrees. ride_follow: share of the saddle's own rocking (the mount's back as it bounds or trots) her hips take. ride_upright: share of that her back takes back again (she stays more upright than the saddle). ride_bob: how far her back gives (bends forward) with each bounce, degrees for every 10 cm the saddle jumps under her; ride_bob_hz, ride_bob_damp: how quickly that springs back (a spring: its speed in bounces a second, and its damping, 0..1). ride_lean: forward lean at full speed (ride_lean_full_mps). ride_turn: share of a balanced lean into turns, at most ride_turn_max. ride_sway: a slow sway while standing (ride_sway_hz sways a second). ride_jolt: the kick each skill gives her body, + forward, - back (pounce_land when a Pounce comes down); ride_jolt_hz, ride_jolt_damp: how it settles. ride_head_steady: share of all that her head does NOT follow (a rider's head stays level). ride_aim_steady: share of it her chest (and so her bow arms) does not follow while she aims, so drawing and aiming are untouched. ride_bow_*: how she carries the bow while seated and not shooting, measured from her carry pose of the moment: the bow hand lifted (lift_m), out to her side (out_m) and forward (fwd_m), the bow tipped forward (tilt_fwd) and its top out (tilt_out); if its lower tip would still hang lower than clear_m above the saddle, it tips further forward, by up to more_max degrees.
mount._note_clear: 22 Nov 2026 (the owner: the mount's head or ears must never go into the cat): points on the mount's neck, head, ears, horns, nose and jaw (sampled from its mesh) are kept ride_clear_m outside spheres fitted to her head, ear tips and chest. When one comes in she leans away (at most ride_clear_max degrees, about the root of her spine), and if that is not enough slides back on the saddle, at most ride_clear_slide_m. What is left is the mount's own clip (fixed in Blender).

Groups of assault.group_size arrive across shuffled rounds of all four trails: assault.member_gap within groups, random assault.group_gap between them. The leader joins last. Victory requires defeating every raider. The existing per-quality live cap applies with no round breaks. Defeated member IDs and capped summons survive saves; legacy three-wave checkpoints reduce the remaining roster once. Camp/renown level, strength and completion rewards retain their existing formulas; loss consolation uses the defended proportion in legacy_waves shares. All timing uses live frame delta, never wall time.

mission._note: how every mission runs (Draft 7): `waves` waves in chapters of `chapter_waves`; every chapter's last wave is an elite wave (the mission's `elite` enemies, more each chapter) and the mission's last wave brings its `boss`. Wave w has count[0]..count[1] ordinary enemies from its chapter's pool, spawned every[0]..every[1] s apart, at strength (base_strength + strength_per_mission x mission) x (1 + wave_ramp x (w - 1)); at most `max_alive` at once. A `breather` (s) between waves; after a chapter the camp rests until the player goes on from the signpost, and the game is saved there. Pay: kills drop `kill_pay` of their leaves; a cleared wave pays (wave_bonus + wave_bonus_step x w) leaves; a chapter pays chest_leaves / chest_timber [chapter]; all of it x (1 + pay_per_mission x mission). The win pays the mission's `reward` (replays: `replay_reward` of it). The campfire can be rebuilt once per chapter (`rebuild_s` on the ashes, `rebuild_timber`) and comes back at `rebuild_hp`; at every chapter break it is fed back to full. If a wave's last `flee_left` enemies (no boss) go `flee_after` s without one coming or falling, they flee so the wave can end (Raid Missions only since H1: Random Raid raiders stay until killed).
mission._note_wave_control: 23 Nov 2026: campaign raids and Gloom Raids wait for the player to start every wave. Cleared campaign waves save wave_done, keeping continuous numbering across five-wave supply chests, app restarts and camp falls. Older chapter-only saves resume at that chapter's first wave. Wave-clear leaves and timber are doubled; enemy_leaf_mult increases fresh kill drops without multiplying stolen leaves. Early-start timer pay is retired.
mission._note_phase_f: Phase F (19 Nov 2026): roads = how a wave picks its roads (surround: all four, roads taking turns; pincer: two far apart; rush: one road, rush_count x enemies at rush_speed x speed, with a banner). A mission's `lanes` is now its favoured road (favoured_weight x share in surround; rushes come from it). teach_mission uses teach_roads_by_chapter roads (1, 2, then all 4). burst: enemies come in groups of size[0]..size[1], `spacing` s apart; the gap after a group keeps the chapter's average rate. min_wave_ratio: an ordinary wave is topped up (more enemies, up to max_alive) so its total health is at least this share of the wave before it (not after a chapter break, not the boss wave). boss_adds: share of a boss wave's ordinary enemies (a mission may override). bonus: quick clear (cleared within quick_base_s + quick_per_foe_s per enemy) pays quick_share x the wave bonus; intact (no building or defence ruined in the wave) pays intact_share x the wave bonus; Go early pays early_per_s leaves per breather second skipped (x the pay scale). golden_grub: from mission index from_mission, a chance per wave, it runs across the field and escapes after life_s; it never holds a wave up. totem: from mission index from_mission, a chance per ordinary wave, it grows on a road at trail progress `s`; foes within radius get speed_buff and take (1 - armor) damage; it is a foe (the wave waits for it). Mission keys: needs_home (the home level to start it; ALL 1 since 21 Nov 2026, the owner: missions never wait for a Hearthtree upgrade, they open one after another as each is won), strength_mult, elite_by_chapter (replaces chapter+1), boss_adds, chapter pool_first + first_waves (the chapter's first waves use pool_first).
mission._note_phase_g1: Phase G1 (20 Nov 2026): wave_limits.groups by mission number (to_mission, 1-based): max_alive = the most enemies of a mission wave on the field at once; tanks_at_once = the most tank weight on the field at once (tank_weight: boar 0.5, the big ones 1; elites count, bosses do not); tank_share = the most tank weight in a whole wave as a share of its enemies. boss_others_on_field: with a boss alive, at most this many others on the field. min_wave_ratio now swaps weak kinds for stronger ones from the chapter pool (within the tank limits) and never adds enemies. Rush waves keep their count (roads.rush_count 1.0) and come rush_speed x faster. timber_per_wave: timber for each mission wave held (x the pay scale, rounded, at least 1). rebuild_leaves: the mid-mission campfire rebuild costs this many leaves when the cat has less than rebuild_timber timber.
mission._note_squads: Phase G1b: mission waves are planned from the chapter's `squads` (weights) instead of its random `pool`, until the wave reaches its count from `count`. Rules (squad_rules): from mission mixed_from on, a wave holds at least min_types different squad types; from mission share_from on, no kind is more than max_kind_share of a wave; the chapter's first_waves still use only its first squad. A squad spawns together on one road only when the field has room for all of it and the tank limit allows it. Elites lead their own squads (the elite plus elite_escort light enemies from the chapter's squads). The boss wave: each `boss` entry plus the mission's boss_escort squads.

burrows._note: The Burrows (docs/DUNGEON_SPEC.md; Phase E: docs/PHASE_E_SPEC.md), open once every mission is won. Entry is free and unlimited (the user, 18 Nov 2026). H1 (25 Nov 2026): no Hollow keys; amber is the only material (its drops: the amber block). A Burrow is a dungeon: one continuous map at night (data/dungeons/<map>.json), a path the cat walks from the way in past fights (packs that wake, spawners that fire) to a boss in a big arena (or a treasure clearing), built far from the camp at origin. Replays are levels of the same map: level 1 is open when the Hollow opens, beating level N opens N+1 (Save burrow stats depth = the highest level beaten). Every per-depth table below is per level. Monster health x strength_by_depth x (1 + fight_ramp x the fight's number); bosses x the map's hp_mult; damage = the kind's damage + damage_add_by_depth. Packs: the map's base + per_level x (level - 1) monsters from the level's tier pool (tiers[].first = the level a pool starts), at most max_alive_by_quality; a Gloomtouched elite may join a pack (pack_elite_chance_by_level, from level 1) and from level 2 a Root Snapper (snapper_chance_by_depth). A waking pack wakes any pack asleep within link_r of it (a pull). The spring heals spring.heal of the cat's health; a dew bud blooms where a fight with a pip was won with dew.bud_chance. Harder from 19 Nov 2026 (the user: "make the dungeon quite a lot harder"): strength, damage_add, fight_ramp, elites, wake_r, link_r, max_alive (Medium/High), boss_minions_max, dew, spring, and pay +25% (leaf_mult_by_depth, drops) to match; the boss's own tuning is in the map's end.mods. The first run ever at level 1 uses the map's fixed packs. Nothing is ever given, refilled or taken by time. Satchel: all of it banked on a root lift, knockout_keep of it on a knock-out; leaves, timber and shards are banked at once. A drop value v = floor(v) + a chance frac(v) of one more. Past level 5: strength +strength_per_depth_after a level, pay x (1 + pay_per_depth_after x (level - 5)). `list` holds every Burrow (one now): a new one is data plus models. sealed_guardian: the Moss Warden waits sealed behind the boss on the first clear of that level.

amber._note: H1 (25 Nov 2026, the owner): amber is the one expedition material. It pays for nothing; Bramble buys it (market.buys). All its drops are here (first guesses, tune by play): each value v gives floor(v) and a chance frac(v) of one more (0.5 = a 1 in 2 chance of one). boss: the end's chest (the boss chest, or a treasure end). sealed: the Gloom-bound chest (breaking its seal doubles it, as all that chest's loot: drops.sealed_mult). elite: a Gloomtouched elite's kill. grub: the Amber Grub caught. first_clear: a level beaten for the first time (straight into the satchel). chest_source: which of these a chest pays by, from its map type in the level data (only sealed pays; the boss chest pays boss in code; any type not named pays no amber). Ordinary kills and the other chests drop none. Lucky Paw (boons.lucky) gives no extra amber (the owner, 25 Nov 2026): only more leaves and timber. Picked up, it goes into the satchel; a knock-out keeps half (knockout_keep, rounded down).

attachments._note: Phase E: attachments for the mount and the pet. They help in the Burrows only (burrow_run.gd adds their mods to Data.run_mods with the boons), one worn per companion, bought with leaves (H1: no materials) and worn on the Stable (Market Stall) and Nest (Mushroom Cottage) cards. Card-only for now: no model on the companions yet. mods: mount_hp (+share of the mount's health), thump_mult (+share of its Stomp, the Thump before G4), loot_mult (x chests and kills), trap_warn (+s on trap and spore warnings), pet_dmg (+share of Sprig's sparks), hp (+cat health). G4 (21 Nov 2026): the Mossweave Saddle (mount_saddle) and the Saddlebags (mount_bags) moved to the Saddlery (mount_attachments, working everywhere; old saves keep them there: saddlery.old_attachments). The Thunder Shoes stay here as they were.

saddlery._note: G4 (docs/PHASE_G_PLAN.md, 21 Nov 2026): the Saddlery's own rules (the building itself, its price, levels and needs_missions, is stations.saddlery). gap_s: the shortest time between mount skills; the Fire-spitter has an independent firing clock matching the cat's current shooting interval. free_stomp: a save from before G4 that had won mission `mission` gets that skill at `level`, once (the mount's old built-in Thump). old_attachments: the Burrows-only mount attachments that became Saddlery attachments, old id -> [new id, level] (the level whose numbers match the old item best: the saddle's +50% health -> level 3, +45%; the bags' +25% loot -> level 5, +25% leaves from kills). stand_in: until the owner's Meshy model comes, the Saddlery shows these models by its level, tinted (delete the block then). worn_tie_order (22 Nov 2026, one attachment worn at a time): a save that owns attachments but has none marked worn (one from before that rule) wears the highest-level one it owns; on a tie the first in this list wins (the Saddlebags).

mount_skills._note: G4: the skills the mount learns at the Saddlery. While the cat rides it in a fight (a mission, a raid, the Burrows) it uses each one by itself on its own timer (every_s, frame time only), never two at once (saddlery.gap_s; priority: which ready one goes first). price[0] learns it (level 1); price[n] buys level n + 1 (levels 2-5, never above the Saddlery's level); a price with needs_burrows is sold only once the Burrows are open (after the missions); H1: every price is leaves and timber. Never real money. By level: damage x (1 + damage_per_level x (level - 1)); stun_s + stun_add_per_level x (level - 1); taken + taken_add_per_level x (level - 1). Distances are from the mount's middle, plus the enemy's own radius. Stomp, Ram and Pounce are on the ground (fliers are missed); Bellow reaches fliers too. Bosses are stunned boss_stun_s at most. Stomp also takes the Burrows' thump_mult (the Thunder Shoes). clip: the mount's animation (Thump while the mount has no such clip). Ram and Pounce move the mount and the cat by code (dash_m over dash_s; a leap over leap_s, its clip in place; hop_m only when the mount has no Pounce clip).

bellow.name: Bellow
bellow.text: A mighty call that stuns the enemies round it

mount_attachments._note: G4: what the mount wears, made at the Saddlery, everywhere (missions, raids, the Burrows). 22 Nov 2026 (the owner's rule): the mount can own all three but wears ONE at a time, or none (Save.saddlery.worn); only the worn one acts and shows on the mount. Wear is free, between waves only; a bought one is worn at once when nothing is worn; only the worn one is upgraded. Bought and upgraded like the skills (price, needs_burrows, capped by the Saddlery's level). fire_spitter (23 Nov 2026): while ridden in combat it launches flame balls at the cat's current firing pace, independently of skill gaps. It assists the cat's focus or holds/acquires a foe in any direction within Data.cat_range(), measured from the cat. The firing unit swivels at aim_turn_deg_per_s and waits for aim_tolerance_deg alignment; the harness stays fixed. Flight uses projectile_speed and projectile_radius, with lifetime at least projectile_life_s and enough for the launch distance plus projectile_flight_grace_s; collision bursts around the hit enemy (blast_m plus each foe's radius), applying damage x (1 + damage_per_level x (level - 1)) once to each foe, then burn_per_s x (1 + burn_per_level x (level - 1)) for burn_s to survivors. Damage and burn retain companion meal boosts. Ball flight and impacts stop while gameplay is frozen. Visual effects share their meshes and materials (22 Nov 2026: and, when its file exists, a model on the mount: res://assets/companions/attachments/<id>_<mount look>.glb on the saddle bone, the fire starting at its marker_nozzle; every attachment shows its model the same way). saddle (the Mossweave Saddle): the mount's health x (1 + hp_per_level x level). saddlebags: leaves dropped by kills x (1 + leaves_per_level x level), in missions, raids and the Burrows (the fractions add up from kill to kill).

fire_spitter.name: Fire-spitter
fire_spitter.text: Tracks enemies at the cat's arrow range and firing pace; flame balls burst on nearby enemies
fire_spitter._note_visual_fire: Animated fireball tongues and flame trail; impacts leave a visual ground fire for 3 s, fading during its last 0.8 s. Nearby hits refresh one patch. Counts are capped by graphics quality. Ground fire adds no damage beyond the existing impact and enemy burn, pauses with gameplay and clears on area changes.

market._note: Phase G2: what Bramble sells to the player (sells: amount for leaves) and buys from the player (buys: amount for what he pays, every currency the entry names: leaves, and H1 shards). after_missions: only once every mission is won. Timber is in `trade`, Gloom shards in gloom_raids.shard_trade. H1 (25 Nov 2026, the owner): he buys amber for 1,000 leaves and 1 purple shard each (first guesses) and sells no materials.

enemy_roles._note: Phase G1b: what each kind does in a squad. light: fast, many; fighter: charges; tank: in front, soaks; support: stays behind (shoots, heals, drums); leader: an elite that leads a squad.

squads._note: Phase G1b (approved by the owner 20 Nov 2026): a wave is a list of squads, small teams with roles. members: kind and n = [min, max]. from_mission: the mission (1-based) it first appears in. A squad comes down one road together: the tank (or the fighter, or the first member) leads, light ones keep pace, support stays a few steps behind; near the camp they break off. Elite waves: squads led by the mission's elite. Boss wave: the boss with the mission's boss_escort squads.

pools._note: Phase H (H1, 25 Nov 2026): the object pools (core/pools.gd, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md part 4). How many of each are made ahead when the camp opens, per graphics level [Low, Medium, High]. Not a cap: a pool that runs out makes more and keeps them. arrows: the cat's arrows in flight; numbers: damage numbers and text pop-ups (one shared pool); hit_fx: the leaf bursts of enemy hits (Fx.hit); pickups: leaves and the other pickups. First guesses, to be measured on the phone (--perf, --raidperf, docs/PERFORMANCE.md).

save_upgrades._note: core/save_upgrades.gd: what an upgrade step needs from the data. Frozen with the save format it upgrades: never tune these, they are what the older game paid. to_v3 (H1, 25 Nov 2026, the owner): a version-2 save's amber, glowstone and heartwood (its mats, and the satchel of a run saved halfway) and its Hollow keys turn into leaves at what Bramble paid for them before H1 (mat_leaves: each material; key_leaves: each key; key_cap: the most keys the old loader held, more are cut down to it).
